main_text.l: pulsis in formam provinciæ redege-runt.Expugnatio hæc,in quàMathematicorum ingeniosissimus, & mirificorum operum artifex maximus Archimedes, studiis suis intentus periit, accidit Olympiadis cxli anno quarto, qui erat urbis Romæ conditæ dxlii, Appio Claudio Pulchro, & Q. Fulvio Flacco iii consulibus, ab initio regni Hieronis lviii, ex quo idem Prætor creatus fuerat lxiiii. Tum Syracusæ ornamentis plurimis, quæ tolli poterant, operibus clarissimorum artificum spoliatæ, eaque Romam translata: urbs tota fœdè direpta à militibus, ædificiis alia injuria non illata, cædes inermium nullæ factæ. Dehinc urbs eadem sub imperio populi Romani quieta mansit, intacta bellis servilibus, adhuc florens tempore Ciceronis, ut ex actionibus ejus in Verrem satis conspicuum est: demum à Sexto Pompeio Siciliam contra C. Cæsarem Octavianum, & M. Antonium obtinente fœdè vastata, & sensim sequenti ævo maximâ sui parte defolata. Reliquiæ denique intra insulam, olim partem ejus minimam, arctatæ.

page.notes: The page is a single printed page, page 146. The first word "pulsis" is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Doubtful readings: "senfim" is printed with a long s; I read it as "sensim" (the [?] mark is not used because the letters are clear). "cxli", "dxlii", "lviii", "lxiiii" and "iii" are printed in lowercase numerals and are copied as printed. Show-through from the facing page is ignored.
